description: Remove dark mode toggle redundancy from topbar - theme controls should ONLY exist in Settings page. Per Nielsen's Heuristic #8 (Aesthetic and Minimalist Design), avoid exposing infrequently-used configuration in the primary workspace. Theme preference is a one-time setup action that belongs in Settings. Also remove the /reports page redirect to /dashboard (it is redundant since reports has no functionality). The seed and query pages are dev utilities with no sidebar link and should remain as-is.
steps: In src/components/app-shell.tsx: Remove the theme toggle button from the topbar area (the button with handleThemeToggle onClick). Remove the import of MoonStar, SunMedium, Monitor icons if they become unused (check if Settings page imports them separately - it does via its own imports). Remove the handleThemeToggle function from the shell. Keep all theme initialization/sync logic intact since Settings page will still emit 'skyhub:settings-preview' events for theme changes.

In src/app/(app)/reports/page.tsx: This page just redirects to /dashboard. Remove this redirect page entirely (delete the file). Reports is not in the navigation items for any role and has no purpose.
In src/lib/access.ts: Remove '/reports' from any route arrays if it exists (it does not appear to be there, but verify). No changes needed here.

Verify that the theme toggle in Settings (ThemePreviewCard components) still works correctly after removing the topbar toggle - it uses the skyhub:settings-preview custom event which the shell already listens to.
acceptance_criteria: No theme toggle button visible in the topbar header area
Theme can still be changed from Settings > Preferensi tab using ThemePreviewCard
Shell still responds to skyhub:settings-preview events for live theme preview
The /reports route no longer exists (page deleted)
verification: Run `pnpm lint` and confirm no new errors
Run `pnpm build` and confirm successful compilation
Grep for handleThemeToggle in app-shell.tsx - should not exist
Confirm reports/page.tsx file does not exist
findings: Lint passes clean (0 warnings). Build compiles 22 pages (down from 23 - reports removed). Theme toggle removed from topbar, all theme sync logic preserved for Settings page. No references to handleThemeToggle, MoonStar, SunMedium, Monitor remain in app-shell.tsx.
